text: In the fall of 2020, the Eighth Street Cenotaph was moved to its new home in Colonel Samuel Smith Park due to the development of a condominium project at the site of the former Royal Canadian Legion Branch 3. This Motion requests authority from Council to amend the Approved 2021 Capital Budget and 2022-2030 Capital Plan for Parks, Forestry and Recreation to create a new capital sub-project for improvements to the Cenotaph in Colonel Samuel Smith Park, with a project cost and cash flow commitments of $292,000 in 2021. Improvements to the Cenotaph will include a gathering space, connecting pathway, lighting and landscaping. The improvements will be fully funded by a Section 37 community benefit obtained from the development at 2115-2139 Lake Shore Boulevard West and various Section 42 Above 5 percent Cash-in-lieu, generated from developments in proximity to Colonel Samuel Smith Park.…
